Carrier FY2024 total net sales were $22.5B; the Climate Solutions Transportation segment (Carrier Transicold + Sensitech combined) reported $3,475M in FY2024. Sensitech revenue not separately disclosed. Sensitech homepage cites 16M shipments monitored annually across 130 countries. In August 2024 Sensitech acquired Berlinger & Co. Monitoring Solutions, expanding pharma cold-chain capability.
